name: Le Meridien Stuttgart
positioning: City-center Le Méridien Stuttgart opposite the Schlossgarten park, with an 850 square meter spa and pool
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to Stuttgart's castles, opera, Staatsgalerie and Königstraße
Guests who want a large in-house spa with pool and saunas
Art lovers who want free entry to the Staatsgalerie Stuttgart

facts.text: The hotel is directly opposite the Schlossgarten park, a few minutes' walk from Stuttgart Central Station.
Across the park lies the Königstrasse, Stuttgart's central street for shopping and entertainment.
Guests can walk to the Königstraße, the Staatsgalerie, the state opera and both the New and Old Castles.
Le SPA covers 850 square meters, with a swimming pool, a 24/7 gym, treatments, and a bar and bistro.
The spa's sauna area has a 70 degree sauna, a 90 degree sauna and an infrared cabin.
Le SPA treatments include classic massages, hot stone ceremonies, Ayurvedic massages and foot massages.
Rooms have views of the green garden or the city, with modern furniture and innovative art.
Bathroom amenities are by MALIN + GOETZ.
The restaurant serves a Sunday brunch with live cooking stations and an à la carte dinner menu of regional and international specialties.
Bar Lillet is named after the house aperitif Lillet, a French aperitif that inspired Bond author Ian Fleming.
The meeting foyer has a spiral staircase.
The Mercedes-Benz Museum is 10 minutes by car from the hotel, and the Porsche Museum is reachable by public transport.

highlights.text: All rooms and suites include complimentary access to the 850 square meter spa area with pool.
Through the Unlock Art program, guests get free entry to the Staatsgalerie Stuttgart by showing their room key; the museum holds 800 years of art.
The largest suites have a separate living room, library and conference space, with an open fireplace or a conservatory.
At Le SPA, guests can swim laps in the heated pool, relax in the sauna or enjoy the sun in the garden.

considerations.text: The pool has a daily kids splash time, so expect families in the pool during those hours.
The Mercedes-Benz Museum is a car ride away rather than a walk.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack a tranquil atmosphere.
